verdicts.reason: A: the white card covers almost the whole canvas, so the architectural photo is reduced to slivers in the top corners and the original's photo-plus-card split is lost. The 'NOW OPEN' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, breaking the reading order, and the centred CTA clashes with the left-aligned text block and is jammed under the eyebrow. B: the logo sits on the busy photo and the 'MONOGRAPH' wordmark runs across the card edge, an unintended collision. 'GALLERY' has almost no contrast against the image, 'NOW OPEN' is again out of order below the body and oversized, and the headline wraps awkwardly. B's collision and illegible logo text make it worse than A, which is clean but loses the imagery.
